calibration.policy: No automatic selection: independent representative labels, confidence bounds and risk-owner approval remain mandatory; a feasible synthetic point estimate does not establish quality acceptance

diagnostics.commonality_definition: A query token appears in at least 12 distinct retrieved corpus records; diagnostic only, never used to tune scoring.
diagnostics.source_scope: quality-global/private are fictional dataset labels; category labels are synthetic query strata and confounded with entity type. They are not measurements of official OFAC/UN/UK quality.
diagnostics.transliteration_scope: Explicit synthetic native-script aliases only; automatic transliteration is not implemented or assessed.

labels: Deterministic typed-namespace contract examples; not independently adjudicated identity truth
limitations: Artificial random unique names avoid name collisions and are not representative identity prevalence
Same-name different-passport examples are indeterminate: people can hold multiple passports
Missing namespace is rejected by request validation and is covered by separate unit/security tests, not labelled a true negative
No transliteration or real official-source quality claim; no LEI/IMO checksum-validation claim
Family partitions have distinct identifiers and names but share generation rules; no statistical independence or production acceptance claim
